caption:
People are saving less. 📉
The BEA says the U.S. personal saving rate fell to 3.8% in September. Prices (PCE) are up 3.6% from a year ago, and spending is outpacing income.
In plain English: more of each paycheck is going to just keeping up.
Are you saving more, less, or the same as last year?
first_comment: Be honest: how much of your paycheck can you actually save now? 👇

instagram.first_comment: Saving rate hits 3.8%. Are you saving less too? Tell @paychecktruths 👇
